title: A GIFT OF TIME LIMITED-TIME EVENT OPEN
lines: 01 A GIFT OF TIME LIMITED-TIME EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: During the event, players can claim rewards, including Event Exclusive Furniture, Materials and Furniture Parts. These special rewards will be sent via in-game mail.
Contents: Event Exclusive Furniture 'Astrolabe Bunny Cake', Furniture Part *500, Tactical Battle Record *20
Contents: Event Exclusive Furniture 'Nebula-1', LMD *50000, Strategic Battle Record *30

After December 23, 2024, 05:30 (UTC-7), a thank-you letter from Amiya will be sent to all players who have registered and created an account before December 23, 2024, 05:30 (UTC-7) via in-game mail. This mail will be valid for 10 days.
02 TEST COLLECTION NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
Test Collection - Solo Around The World for Amiya (Incantation Medic)
During this outfit launch, players who purchase the outfit will receive "Bunny Serenade" Icon *1 for free. The bonus icon will be sent within two week s after the outfit sale ends.
Please stay tuned for more information!
